sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- S.N. Jaiswal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 05.02.1992 passed by Sri Suresh Chandra, Vth Additional Sessions Judge, Bulandshahr in Criminal Appeal No. 23 of 1991 dismissing appeal, confirming the judgement and order dated 26.02.1991 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate VI (E.O), Bulandshahr in Criminal Case No. 2702 of 1990, convicting appellant for the offence under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment and also impose fine of Rs. 1000/- and in case of non-payment of fine, he shall further suffer two months rigorous imprisonment.
Being aggrieved, revisionist preferred present revision.

procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

5. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
